children: Oil prices are strengthening after Russia pounded Ukrainian energy targets, hours after President Trump declared an "energy ceasefire" between the two countries.

Diesel futures have also pared their declines. A supply deal with Russia struck last week would likely have a limited effect on prices. Traders are also on edge about the Middle East, where Iran-backed Houthi militants carried out lethal strikes on Saudi Arabia's main airport over the weekend.
U.S. stocks are trading mixed, while bond markets will stay closed today for Columbus Day, marked by some as Indigenous Peoples' Day.

Looking ahead, earnings season will kick into gear with results from big U.S. banks Tuesday and Wednesday. Also in focus: consumer price inflation data due on Wednesday, and a public appearance by Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh on Thursday at a summit being held in Bangkok by the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank.
